accepted_risks.scope: The exact single legacy noteai_xhs-to-noteai_admin edge observed in production for first launch only.
prohibited_expansion: No new membership edge, role, ADMIN OPTION, ownership, DDL, role-management or database privilege for noteai_xhs.
No change to the observed ADMIN true, INHERIT false and SET false option tuple.
accepted_risks.actual_effective_privileges: CONNECT and schema USAGE plus the fixed XHS table, column and three-sequence matrix; zero CREATE, TEMPORARY, grant option, ownership, function, default-ACL or matrix mismatch.
compensating_controls: RDS has no public endpoint and current full backups are available.
Runtime secrets remain node-local root-owned 0600 files and API/Admin listeners remain loopback-only.
Schema migrations execute as the persistent noteai_admin migration owner through a protected executor, never noteai_xhs.
invalidates_on: Any membership edge or option drift.
Any new effective or grantable privilege, ownership or default ACL for noteai_xhs.
Loss of the private-network, protected-secret or current-backup controls.
accepted_risks.remediation: Optionally remove the historical edge with provider assistance after first launch and complete review within 30 days.

accepted_risks.scope: The exact existing noteai_app ROLINHERIT attribute observed with zero incoming membership and zero high-privilege inheritance for first launch only.
prohibited_expansion: No incoming membership or high-privilege inheritance for noteai_app.
No new role-management, database-create, replication, bypass-RLS, ownership or grantable capability.
accepted_risks.actual_effective_privileges: ROLINHERIT is enabled, but incoming membership count and high-privilege inheritance count are both zero; the fixed role and ACL matrix remains otherwise exact.
compensating_controls: The complete role graph and effective ACL matrix are checked before and after the schema transaction.
RDS remains private, runtime secrets remain protected and current full backups are available.
invalidates_on: Any inherited SUPERUSER, CREATEROLE, CREATEDB, REPLICATION or BYPASSRLS capability.
Loss of the private-network, protected-secret or current-backup controls.
accepted_risks.remediation: Review conversion to NOINHERIT after first launch and complete the review within 30 days.
